messages.请先等待后台任务完成，再重启。: Wait for background jobs to finish before restarting.

messages.文件选择器适应较矮的窗口，目录、文件和已选项可分别滚动。: The file picker fits shorter windows, with separate scrolling for folders, files and selected items.
messages.按需检查官方版本，下载验证签名后安装，由你选择重启。: Check official releases on demand, verify signatures before installation and choose when to restart.
messages.统一 GitHub 仓库、文档、反馈与发行版入口，提供中英发布说明。: Consistent repository, documentation, feedback and release links, with bilingual release notes.
messages.网页书签元数据与远程封面、Markdown 中的远程图片可能访问对应网站。更新仅: Bookmark metadata, remote covers and Markdown images may contact their websites. Update checks contact official GitHub Releases only on demand, and artifacts are used after signature verification. GitHub and external help open in your system browser. There is no background telemetry, automatic upload or cloud file index.
